capabilities: zoom and pan rendered Mermaid diagrams with fit-chart and fit-width presets
open diagrams in an independently fitted lightbox
edit diagram source in place with validated save
inspect and highlight semantic elements on hover
export diagrams as SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP
extras: Released at 0.1.0 from a renamed source with a documented settings-migration helper from the author's legacy plugin; real mobile keyboards/touch and coexistence with Mica are explicitly unqualified. Manual installation instructions and automated release provenance checks are included.
intentEvidence: adds native-scale navigation, semantic interaction, source editing and image export to existing Mermaid SVGs
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams as static SVGs with no zoom, pan, fitted lightbox view, direct source editing or image export.

relations.evidence: For an existing, confirmed DevGuyRash installation with ID devguyrash-mermaid-viewer, disable that plugin

summary: Mermaid diagram viewer that adds zoom, drag panning, lightboxes, semantic hover highlighting, in-place source editing and image export to rendered diagrams.
